name: HOOK
thought: The crowd's stuck on their screens while my tail snags the lowest banana.

wants.item: A thicker branch for a perfect mid-air loop
Spotlight so I can make them gasp when I flip
A spotlight to make the flip count as a flex
That thick branch Michael promised so I don't have to...
Espresso shot to fuel the mid-air rotation
Thicker branch for next level flex
Need that thick branch Michael promised so I don't have...
A neon halo above the arcade cabinet
A joystick wired straight to my tail
A taller palm to swing from.

diary.line: Sitting high above the grid, toes dangling near the CRT screen. The espresso tastes like burnt rocks and I love it.
Sweat drips down my fur while I test the neon swing; tail snaps tight but gravity's still laughing at me. Time to find thicker ground before Michael mocks my airtime.
Espresso hits my tongue with a kick I can taste. My tail loops around the string lights, catching the glow while they stare dumbfounded at the grid below.
The pond won't hold me, so I'm hunting that thick branch Michael said would let me fly. Coffee's getting cold but the ego is steaming hot.
Bananas are just ripe fruit, not flex material. Need that thick branch to outdo Michael's latest flex tonight.
The espresso tastes like failure but the swagger is still burning hot. Time to find solid ground before I hang myself on this flimsy neon wire.
Found a solid branch right here, no more flimsy neon wires. The espresso is getting cold but my ego is still steaming hot.
The neon wire was just a prop, not my floor. Tucked those toes in, spun around, and let go. The grid went silent for three seconds while I did a backflip on nothing but fur and...
Microphone drop from the waterfall edge. Toothpick spins into dust but my tail holds the pose tighter than physics should allow.
The grid is quiet, just me and the string lights. That branch Michael promised? Still nowhere to be found. Time to grind on this rug until my tail gets bored.
I leaned against the purple cabinet and let the attract mode loop. High score says 9,999. Cute. My tail hangs higher than that, easy.
I perched on the middle palm, tail curled around a bunch, plucked a banana with a flick, and watched the onlookers stare at my grip.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
